label: Task-8
title: Implement graph data fetching API
description:
Backend endpoint to fetch node with connected nodes.

## Requirements
- GET /nodes/api/nodes/{label}/graph?depth=N
- Return node + all nodes within N link hops
- Include link information for rendering edges

## Response Shape
```json
{
  "root": "Feature-11",
  "nodes": [...],
  "links": [...]
}
```
